name: Basic search
what_was_promised: Text match; results sorted by departure time
audit_verdict: implemented but defined differently from paper
notes: Paper says 'sorted by departure time'; code sorts by |departure - preferred time|. Fix the paper's definition.

name: + Feasibility filter
what_was_promised: PostGIS proximity; segment seats; time window; OSRM relative detour; EV energy with charger insertion
implementation_evidence: sim has one origin/destination (sim/frozen.py); platform: 5 km radius, segment seats, day-level date, absolute detour minutes (core-api ride/DetourService.java), EV per-stretch range at publish only (ride/RideService.java:558)
necessary_to_add: only if B1 stays in the paper
notes: Protocol s.2: 'Not built: the simulated corridor has one origin and one destination'. Eq. (5) relative detour and eq. (6) SoC/reserve/charger insertion are not implemented anywhere.

name: + Two-sided match score (LightGBM)
what_was_promised: P_book x P_accept from two calibrated LightGBM classifiers with class-balanced weights and isotonic calibration
implementation_evidence: No LightGBM/SHAP in intel/requirements.txt or requirements-research.txt; platform MatchScore.java is a rule-based 0-100 score from stated preferences, distance, price and record ('never anything predicted')
necessary_to_add: no (remove from paper or describe the rule-based score as platform-only)
notes: Simulator: driver accepts with fixed probability 0.85 (world.yaml supply.accept_probability); passenger books the top-ranked ride with a type-specific fixed probability. No choice model exists to learn.

name: + CommitmentDecay ranking
what_was_promised: Rank by expected completion M x S_b(D|t0) x S_drv(D); Cox/GB blend
implementation_evidence: sim/simulator.py:_rank ranks by Cox conditional survival only (variants/B3.yaml, model h3-cox); no blend (experiments/hazard/train.py fits but never blends or serves GB); no driver survival; no M
audit_verdict: supports a small ranking gain; mechanism is timing (see B3-KM)
notes: B3-KM (no features) keeps all of B3's gain: -0.004 per 100 (95% bootstrap -0.025 to +0.017), audit_h3.

name: Ranking with no-feature Kaplan-Meier
what_was_promised: Isolates value of features in B3
audit_verdict: key ablation; mathematically equals 'earliest departure within the +/-2 h window' because S depends only on hours to departure
necessary_to_add: yes: add explicit EARLIEST-DEPARTURE heuristic baseline
notes: Must appear in the paper: the survival framing is not needed for B3's gain in this world.

name: + Rule-based intervention
what_was_promised: Ask bookings with S<theta in order of risk until budget spent
implementation_evidence: variants/B4.yaml: threshold 0.8, once per booking, never within 24 h, scored every 24 h; sim/simulator.py:_scoring_rounds
audit_verdict: null on booking-weighted primary metric; positive on seat-weighted (exploratory)
notes: Paper's B4 spends a budget; implementation asks everyone below threshold (budget appears only in B5).

name: Intervention with no-feature model
what_was_promised: Isolates features in choosing whom to ask

name: Intervention on B0 ranking
what_was_promised: Component removal: intervention without survival ranking
audit_verdict: all of B4's booking-level gain over B0 is the ranking

name: + CP-SAT scheduler
what_was_promised: Multi-action (4 actions) + supply-gap nudges sharing budget; gain = v_b[S(D|a)-S(D)]; exclusion window h
implementation_evidence: intel/app/scheduler/plan.py: single action (reconfirm), worth=(1-S)*seats*min(1,h/168), limits per round/ride/seats-per-day; no nudges, no exclusion window (once per booking ever)
audit_verdict: scheduler does not beat random choice
notes: AI_ML_METHODOLOGY.md s.7: 'at this corridor's scale the seat limit rarely binds'.

name: Upper bound: ask exactly the late cancellers
notes: Clearly labelled as non-implementable bound; good practice.

name: + Static tiered refund
required_by: Paper Table III; s.III-E; report docx s.6.4 (stated as the reference configuration)
what_was_promised: Time-tiered refund schedule replacing B0-B5's single rule
implementation_evidence: platform: application.yml journex.refund.tiers (48 h:100%, 24 h:50%); simulator has no prices, fees or refunds
audit_verdict: unsupported as experiment; the report's stated reference baseline does not exist
notes: Paper's example breakpoints (24 h / 6 h) differ from the platform's (48 h / 24 h). Paper says B0-B5 'apply a single refund rule': the simulator applies none.

name: + Hazard-priced passenger tiers
what_was_promised: Tier fees from model-predicted expected refund cost
implementation_evidence: No code. ROADMAP 'What will not be built': no price changed because of a predicted risk; DECISIONS/CLAUDE.md
notes: Eq. (20) also has a mathematical issue (unconditional density after t0); see statistical_analysis.md.

name: + Driver commitment pricing
implemented: no (as specified); record-based variant on platform
implementation_evidence: payment/KeptRides.java + application.yml kept-rides: lower fee from the record ('never from a prediction'); no driver survival model; sim has one driver per ride, no history
necessary_to_add: no (rewrite as platform feature or remove)

name: + Dynamic and mid-route refilling
what_was_promised: Released segments resold immediately incl. after departure
implementation_evidence: sim: released seats re-sold immediately in every variant (sim/simulator.py:_request refill); no mid-route (single segment, whole corridor); platform: mid-route booking (feature 84)
audit_verdict: not an increment in any run
notes: Cannot be a ladder step: it is on in B0 already.

name: + Cascade-aware recovery (joint CP-SAT)
what_was_promised: Joint re-planning of all passengers of a withdrawn ride; passenger confirms
implementation_evidence: sim: retry (world.yaml demand.retry) + flexible rebooking closest-in-time per passenger (sim/simulator.py:_after_withdrawal); platform booking/FlexibleRebooking.java sequential, auto-books passengers who pre-chose flexible; no CP-SAT recovery anywhere
audit_verdict: recovery adds rides in proportion to uptake (+0.04 to +0.15 per 100)
notes: Paper says 'nothing is rebooked until the passenger confirms'; implementation rebooks at once on prior consent. Reword.

name: Full system + demand calibration + supply-gap nudges
what_was_promised: Count-model demand estimate; nudges sharing the scheduler budget
implementation_evidence: FEATURE_MATRIX row 89 'Not started, by decision'; supply gaps exist on the platform only (supply/SupplyGapService.java), not in sim or scheduler

name: Leave-one-out from B11
what_was_promised: Remove each component from the full system
necessary_to_add: no; replace by the component-removal set that exists (B3-KM; B4-KM; ASK-ONLY; B5-RANDOM)
